'As an additional cost to play this, BANISH A RANDOM CARD FROM YOUR HAND. If a card with 6 or more {p} is banished this way, this gets go again. Blood Debt.'

Was authored as DISCARD_RANDOM -- the wrong zone, and not a smaller version of the printed cost but a different one: a discarded card is in the graveyard, where this deck can get it back. There was no hand-banish cost type until now.

The cost is CARD-LEVEL rather than on the ability, because interpreter._run_ability re-checks and re-pays an ability's additional_costs on every dispatch -- on a WHILE_STATIC that would banish a card per attack-power recalculation and then abort the ability once the hand emptied.

Which card was banished is settled while paying and cannot change afterwards, so the WHILE_STATIC reading (CR 6.2.3d) gives the same answer as reading it once -- and that shape is what loader.conditional_keywords infers from, without which the printed GoAgain applied unconditionally and the 6-power gamble paid out every time. Blood Debt is a printed keyword and needs no JSON.
